summary: Fills the `{{ key }}` placeholders of a template from an object.
description: Whitespace inside the braces is ignored, so `{{name}}` and `{{ name }}` are the same placeholder. A key that the object does not carry is left as it stands, which makes a missing value visible rather than silently blank; `onMissing: "empty"` removes it instead.
`escape` takes a function applied to every substituted value — pass `escapeHtml` when the result goes into a page.

params.template: The template string with `{{ key }}` placeholders.
params.data: The object the values come from.
params.options: `onMissing` is `"keep"` or `"empty"`; `escape` is a function applied to each value.

returns: the template with its placeholders filled.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the template is not a string, or the data is not an object.

examples.title: Filling a template
examples.body:
```javascript
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", { name: "Ada" }); // => "Hi Ada!"
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", {}); // => "Hi {{ name }}!"
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", {}, { onMissing: "empty" }); // => "Hi !"
```
